confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant meal, coffee and draught beer anchors are the best grounded: 2026 aggregated cost-of-living guides and surveys agreed closely in search-result summaries, though some were refreshed after the July 2026 window and are used as proxies. Beer assumes a standard draught serving; sources mix half-litre and pint measures. Cocktail is anchored on a 2025 UK-wide average with a modest 2026 uplift and cross-checked against the draught beer relationship. Wine is the weakest price input: on-trade data was thin or dated, so the 175 ml glass is set from its usual relationship to draught beer and cross-checked against 2026 pub examples. Accommodation anchors are holistic July estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation search or live listing was checked. Local prices were converted at an assumed planning rate of about 1.34 USD per GBP, not retrieved by search; this is the main unverified input. FX is the RBA observation for 2026-11-18 as reported in search results for the RBA exchange-rates page; no 2026-11-19 figure was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: Cardiff-specific food and drink basis from 2026 aggregated guides and surveys; cocktail and wine partly referenced to UK-wide on-trade averages and to the draught beer relationship; accommodation by general comparison with mid-sized UK regional cities with similar July tourism demand, such as Bristol and Birmingham.
